title: Batch Plan
description: Writer jobs generated from definition manifests. Each job owns one editable layer and may optimize multiple definitions serially. Explicit dependencies release ready work; resource limits bound concurrent workers.

run_id.description: Stable id for this batch (used in status.json and the per-target output hash). Defaults to 'batch' when absent.

source_manifest.description: Optional path to the apply-restructure-manifest.json whose phase4_targets[] this plan was built from (provenance for the handoff).

targets.description: One writer job per editable layer; multiple definitions may share a writer.

path.description: The target's own root-layer file path. SO's edit target IS this file's bytes.

role.description: Restructure role (mirrors the manifest phase4_targets[] target_class, plus 'monolith' for an N=1 optimize-as-is run).

target_class.description: Alias accepted for role (matches the manifest field name).

level.description: Descent level carried from the manifest (drives ordering / weight, not authority).

archetype.description: large-spatial | encapsulated-product | piping | generic — selects which op-chain steps apply.

dep_group.description: Legacy dependency translation: dependent_after waits for all shared_first jobs unless explicit depends_on is present. Independent jobs can start immediately.

gpu_bound.description: When true and the runtime_context reports no CUDA, the runner SKIPS the target (state skipped_gpu_unavailable) rather than entering a long CPU fallback.

command.description: Argv for the standalone single-asset worker process. The worker runs the per-target op chain (e.g. meshCleanup -> deduplicateGeometry -> computeExtents; pruneLeaves is NOT in the per-prototype chain) and emits its summary to summary_path.

timeout_sec.description: Per-target wall-clock budget; a worker exceeding it is killed (state timeout), bounding a hung op without stalling the batch.

summary_path.description: Worker summary containing measured before/after and verified per-definition outcomes. Strict jobs require one result per owned definition.

steps_applied.description: Op-chain steps planned/applied for this target (advisory; the worker summary is authoritative for outcome).

input_files.description: Source USD, referenced/payload layers, textures and operation configuration files. Include the complete dependency set for resume.

runtime_files.description: Runtime binaries, plugins and worker scripts whose content affects the result. Resume hashes these files and the command executable.

output_files.description: Written USD layers and other required artifacts. Missing or changed outputs invalidate resume.
